Size sales and cancellations
Task
Tables
Metrics

Across all invoices, how many sale and cancellation invoices are there, what are gross sales, cancelled value and net sales, and what share of gross sales was cancelled?

Context

Before comparing years, establish control totals for the whole period: how much was invoiced, and how much was taken back by cancellation invoices.

What to return

one summary row

sale_invoices
cancellation_invoices
gross_sales
cancelled_value
net_sales
cancellation_rate
Guidance

Invoices and invoice lines are different units: count invoices with DISTINCT after the join.

Use CASE inside SUM to split sale and cancellation value in one pass.

cancelled_value is already negative, so the rate needs a minus sign to be positive.
